subject.title: WhatsApp: add configurable send retry for transient network errors

question: Should WhatsApp get a new default-enabled immediate send retry config, or should this PR be closed/narrowed in favor of the shipped durable delivery queue and reconnect drains?
rationale: Current main already owns reconnect loss through durable queued delivery, while this branch adds a new config/default surface and retry owner with duplicate-delivery risk; automation cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Do not add default-on retry
options.body: Keep the durable queue/reconnect drain as the supported recovery path and close or narrow this PR unless a specific pre-connect retry gap remains.

options.title: Accept a narrow retry surface
options.body: Allow a WhatsApp retry knob only if it is default-off or pre-connect-only, wired through current outbound code, and backed by upgrade/no-duplicate proof.

options.title: Adopt the full branch after rework
options.body: Proceed with configurable immediate retry only after a full rebase, current-path wiring, generated artifact sync, and real WhatsApp behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Do not add default-on retry
recommendation.body: Keep the durable queue/reconnect drain as the supported recovery path and close or narrow this PR unless a specific pre-connect retry gap remains.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the shipped WhatsApp reconnect drain behavior that overlaps this PR's core reliability goal.
